item.title: Option for Anova Missing
item.description: Hi Guys I'm trying to do a Multiway anova for my assignment, I want the ANOVA to help me evaluate the differences between the products for all skin types, dry and oily skin. I assumed the best way to do this is a Multi-way anova because you cannot do a 3 way T test. Please help me, :'( It's due tomorrow but todays a PH so my lecturer isn't replying and Idk what to do Can I even compare these data points? Surely I can?! Ahhh. Do I do T tests comparing Dry to All and All to Dry? (I've done Dry to Oily already) PLEASE HELP Im so stressed,
